title: Segmented control
brief: A three-way view switcher in a soft track. The active segment is a white raised pill, the others tint on hover, and keyboard focus draws a green ring.

inspiration.note: Took the grouped buttons where the selected one is lifted from a shared track; ours has a rounded pill track and a soft shadow.
Took the idea of one selected segment and hover on the rest; the project-view labels and green focus ring are ours.
